title: orchis papilionacea var. rubra
intro: Orchis papilionacea var. rubra, commonly known as the red helleborine, is a rare and endangered orchid species found in Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of red helleborine include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include acting as an expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory, while its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds.
